component.name: prisM. Suite
component.summary: Unified desktop launcher and package manager for the prisM creative suite

description.p: prisM. Suite is a native desktop launcher, package manager, and auto-updater for triM. (video editor), steM. (audio workstation), and beaM. (RAW photo editor).

ul.li: Automated release discovery and cryptographically verified installations
Instant zero-downtime rollbacks via atomic version switching
Automatic synchronization of desktop preferences and interface language
Direct launch management with isolated process group lifecycle control
